Chezmoi dotfiles repository: https://github.com/pascalandy/dotfiles. Source: `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`; target: `~/`; `chezmoi apply` copies files, not symlinks.

Files in `~/` that are managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly.
Always edit the source in `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` or use `chezmoi edit`.
`chezmoi managed | grep <filename>`
`chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc`

Naming: `dot_` → leading dot; `private_` → 600/700 permissions (still visible in git); `executable_` → executable; `symlink_` → symlink; `.tmpl` → template; `run_before_` → before apply; `run_after_` → every apply; `run_once_` → first apply.

`chezmoi add ~/.newfile`
`git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push`

**Preference**: Store user scripts in `~/.local/bin/` (XDG-compliant standard location).
`code ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`
`chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`
`chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`
Scripts are stored in chezmoi as: `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`
Ensure `~/.local/bin` is in PATH (add to `.zshrc` if needed):
`export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"`
**Note**: Script names should NOT have `.sh` extension for cleaner CLI usage.

All bash scripts follow `dot_config/opencode/skill/bash/scripts/pref_bash_script_template.sh`:
`set -euo pipefail`
Functions: `fct_*`; logging: `log_*`; constants/env: `UPPER_CASE`; locals: `lower_case`.
`log_info "Starting process"`
`log_error "Something failed"`
`local message="${1:-Unknown error}"`
`local exit_code="${2:-1}"`
`log_error "${message}"`
`exit "${exit_code}"`

Key paths: `dot_zshrc`, `dot_gitconfig`, `dot_Brewfile`, `dot_local/bin/`, `dot_config/`, `private_dot_ssh/`, `private_dot_gnupg/`, `.chezmoiscripts/run_before_sync.sh`, `.chezmoiscripts/run_after_backup.sh`, `bienvenue_chez_moi/`.

Files containing `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension:
`opencode.json.tmpl`
Define variables in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`:
`openrouter_api_key = "sk-or-v1-.."`
`chezmoi cat ~/.zshrc`

`.chezmoiscripts/` syncs VS Code settings, keybindings and extensions; backs up external files and copies `bienvenue_chez_moi`. `.chezmoiignore` excludes `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `.env*`, `.DS_Store`. Recovery: `crash_procedure.md`. Docs: https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/command-overview/

cass searches prior agent solutions. Before solving a problem from scratch, check if any agent already solved something similar.
⚠️ NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
`cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5`
`cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json`
`cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json`
`cass capabilities --json # Feature discovery`
`cass robot-docs guide # LLM-optimized docs`
`--robot` / `--json`: machine-readable output; `--fields minimal`: source_path, line_number, agent; `--limit N`, `--agent NAME`, `--days N`: filters. stdout = data only, stderr = diagnostics. Exit 0 = success.
